description: AI-generated estimates per menu order, with separate supplied and reference-recipe batches. Portion scenarios are assumptions, not stall measurements.
referenceScope: The supplier cited HPB SG FoodID generally, without dish-level database IDs, recipes or portion mappings. These values are not presented as HPB-verified figures.

referenceBatch.method: Sum HPB per-100g edible composition multiplied by stated ingredient or comparable dish weights. Apply edible percentage once to as-served weights. Negative trace markers and unavailable values remain unknown. Round new kcal/sodium to 10 units and grams to whole units.
referenceBatch.limitations: Not HPB-verified vendor nutrition. Recipes, portions, sauce retention and alternative choices are unmeasured. Sharing dishes represent the full assumed order. Original supplied estimates are preserved unchanged.
